chapter_seo_title: Burial Weapon Valley: Half-Ancestors Clash Over Living War Sword
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen descends into the Burial Weapon Valley, where a mysterious female half-ancestor wields a living War Sword. He joins four half-ancestors in an attack but is overwhelmed. Deep in the valley, sentient weapons and a chained Ancestral God weapon await.
og_title: Burial Weapon Valley: Half-Ancestor Alliance Broken
og_description: Xiao Chen faces a living War Sword in the deadliest valley in the world. Ancient weapons gain sentience, and a chained Ancestral God weapon breathes death.
twitter_description: A female half-ancestor wields a living War Sword. Xiao Chen and four half-ancestors attack but are scattered. Sentient weapons and a chained divine weapon lie below.
